description: Swimming, held out (physics.md 6.6; replaces swim_lake_shore, retired by the owner 2026-10-09): fall into Lake Las Vegas (XCLW 3000) from its surface 270 above the bed, float, then swim south-east with forward held (Always Run, level view, `stroke` forward) to a 24-degree bank that no capture has used and walk out up it: the stroke cycle, the moment the swimmer reaches the bed and the walk up. The capture loads the cell with `cow` first (the retired scenario's bank rows were captured with the cell not loaded, physics.md 6.6).
